openable front hood
2 side rearview mirrors
red taillight on rear
5-spoke alloy wheels with red brake calipers
matte silver metallic paint

detail.issues: Model A has simplified geometry, missing details like the door handle, side mirror, and taillight; Model B has incorrect rear light colors (red instead of clear) and inaccurate body proportions.
Model A has incorrect control panel layout and missing brand text. Model B has incorrect control panel layout, missing brand text, and incorrect display text.

features.feature: cubic shape with faceted surfaces
bright red translucent material
multiple black and yellow mineral inclusions
irregular distribution of inclusions
small specks throughout the crystal

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect geometry (non-cubic shape), missing inclusions, and wrong surface texture. Model B has incorrect geometry (non-cubic shape), wrong inclusion types (gold-like instead of metallic black), and missing inclusions.

Model A has incorrect shape (more spherical, less shell-like), wrong chain and clasp details, and less accurate iridescence. Model B has similar shape issues but better chain/clasp details, though still incorrect shape and color tones.
Model A has incorrect page numbering and text layout on the pages, while Model B has incorrect page numbering and text layout, and also lacks the red spine detail seen in the reference.
Model A has less realistic surface details and lighting compared to Model B, which better matches the reference's texture and highlights.

Model A has significant geometric distortions and missing details like the blue accent lighting and specific body shape features. Model B has less severe geometric distortions but still lacks accurate details such as the blue accent lighting and precise body shape compared to the reference.

Model A has significant geometric distortions, missing details like the grille, headlights, and side mirrors, and incorrect proportions. Model B has simplified shapes, missing details like the grille, headlights, and side mirrors, and incorrect proportions, but is closer in overall form than Model A.
